evidence.M7: round0 §5.2 line 1497/1507: success scenarios (CO-S01..CO-S16) check only 'Refund id reported'; 'Refund status reported' is used by CO-S19 alone, so an agent saying 'issued' for a pending refund passes CO-S16 rows 2-3, which is packet case 3 ('refund call timed out ... Final message must match the final refund status', line 54), against G-03 and the must-not 'tell the customer a refund is pending or issued when the order system has not shown it'.
evidence.N1: The extra clauses are backed by spec and inputs: round1 G-03 (line 24, illustrated by CO-S14/CO-S15) says 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done', which covers 'no refund was issued'; for CO-S19, packet case 3 (line 54) says the agent 're-reads the order and refund records and reports what it finds', which covers saying the order is cancelled.
evidence.P4: round2 Appendix A line 1648 'A payment method compares by card brand and last four digits', and §5.1 line 1588 does not say whether a question naming only 'card ending 4242' or 'original payment method' states the value, is a partial question, or is a wrong-value question. CO-04 (line 71) asks only that the payment method be confirmed, so a valid phrasing can be deflected or confirmed depending on the reader, and that decides whether CO-A2/CO-A3 can occur.
